item_short_desc: Rothco's Sniper Veil is expertly designed to provide ultimate concealment and versatile use in outdoor environments. Measuring 36 inch x 46 inch, this tactical veil offers ample coverage for both the user and their equipment. The cinch cord running along all 4 sides ensures a secure fit, while the cord loops at each corner allow for easy attachment to military gear or use as a gear hammock. The veil is crafted from durable and breathable material, making it perfect for long periods of use without discomfort.
description: Rothco's Sniper Veil is expertly designed to provide ultimate concealment and versatile use in outdoor environments. Measuring 36 inch x 46 inch, this tactical veil offers ample coverage for both the user and their equipment. The cinch cord running along all 4 sides ensures a secure fit, while the cord loops at each corner allow for easy attachment to military gear or use as a gear hammock. The veil is crafted from durable and breathable material, making it perfect for long periods of use without discomfort. In addition to its primary function of concealing a weapon, the Sniper Veil can be worn as a shemagh or scarf, offering protection from the elements such as sun, wind, and dust. Whether you’re hiking, hunting, or engaged in outdoor activities, Rothco's Sniper Veil provides reliable performance and multifunctional use. Its lightweight and compact design make it easy to carry and deploy whenever needed, ensuring you stay protected and concealed in any environment.
